brief:
Zeteo reported on a week of intensified violence across occupied Palestinian territories, with Israeli settlers carrying out attacks in the West Bank while Israeli military operations in Gaza claimed the life of another journalist. The incidents occurred as Israel's military campaign in Gaza continues and settlement activity persists in the occupied West Bank.

The roundup covered multiple incidents of settler violence and military strikes, reflecting what Zeteo characterized as part of broader patterns of displacement and civilian harm across Palestinian territories under Israeli control.
dek: Zeteo’s weekly round-up of the stories you may have missed out of occupied Gaza and the West Bank, as Israel continues its genocidal war and apartheid policies.
title: Israeli settlers attack Palestinians as Gaza journalist killed in airstrike
